highlights: The iPhone app is now on the App Store.
The server drawer has a Marketplace: add agents, skills and apps, then try a skill or an app in a chat.
Type `@` in a chat to pick a skill or a connected app as well as a teammate.
The app previews text, code, JSON, emails, HTML pages, PDFs and spreadsheets, and shows visual replies as live pages.
Faster reconnects and chat loading, and Korean and Simplified Chinese interfaces.
